title: Hand-plotted temperature lapse rate sounding, Hill AFB, Utah, 2100Z 2 Jul 52
description: Handwritten plot on yellow graph paper of altitude in millibars (vertical axis, roughly 50 to 900 MB, with foot equivalents) versus temperature in °C (horizontal axis). Header notes "2100Z 2 JUL 52 Hill AFB, Utah," "Base Alt. 4,370'" and "No inversion layer present," with a surface temperature of 70°F converted to 21°C. Annotations mark the tropopause, a "Lapse Rate approx 2.5°C/1000' (normal)," a "No lapse rate" segment, a lapse rate of about 5°C/1000' near the base altitude, and a note on the 700 MB reading.
